landmarks.name: Paved pit lane and working apron
landmarks.source_note: Actual mapped pit compound49890775 replaces the former generic block. The mapped compound projects to native4768.76→162.65m across zero. Its three road-facing segments stand11.292–11.459m,15.405–15.656m and12.768–16.367m beyond the road edge. The paving control is rounded by less than10m at the longitudinal ends and ends at a constant10.9m offset before the nearest garage face. Local unstriped apron polygons meet each variable mapped front and exclude the occupied building; the generic outer white stripe therefore stays outside all garage bays. Mapped plan registration has approximately±2m uncertainty. Facade/roof dimensions remain reconstructed. Paving stays beyond a closed pit wall; racing XYZ, banking and handling are unchanged. See pit-dimension-review.json.
landmarks.access: Visual service area outside the closed driving boundary.

landmarks.name: NS Square construction site ground reconstruction
landmarks.source_note: Adjacent-road-level reconstruction inside the exact mapped construction parcel, excluding water, road corridors and architecture at emission. The obsolete floating grandstand was demolished; its coarse DSM roof must not become an earth hill. Absolute pad height is an estimate, not a survey.

landmarks.name: Ritz-Carlton three-storey podium footprint ground reconstruction
landmarks.source_note: Adjacent-road-level building foundation reconstruction confined to the mapped podium outline. The separate lobby driveway rises to Level 3 and is not flattened as an entire commercial property. OSM 16 m height and three levels describe the podium above this estimated foundation; no roof-contaminated DSM base is added.

landmarks.name: Ritz-Carlton road-facing garden beneath the rising driveway ground reconstruction
landmarks.source_note: Bounded frontage subarea only, not the large Marina Centre commercial parcel. Its south boundary follows the actual commercial parcel edge along Raffles Avenue; its rear meets the mapped podium front. Lateral ends extend 10 m beyond the mapped podium ends and remain reconstruction estimates. This removes coarse roof smear from the street-side garden while a separate mapped driveway rises 7.2±2 m toward the Level 3 lobby. The actual podium and raised access are modeled, not flattened into generic terrain. No racing corridor or water is replaced.

landmarks.name: Singapore Flyer terminal foundation ground reconstruction
landmarks.source_note: The former wheel base sampled 12.77 m from the retail terminal roof DSM, then added the operator 165 m structure, incorrectly raising the whole wheel. The terminal corners include lower 2.6–3 m samples and the adjacent road is about 1.37 m. A road+1 m plaza foundation is a bounded estimate, not surveyed MSL. The 150 m rim diameter, 165 m total structural height and 28 capsules are preserved.

landmarks.name: ECP Flyer viaduct 21697558
landmarks.source_note: Actual retained layer-1 ECP/Benjamin Sheares carriageway or Rochor Road exit alignment. Continuous supplied 1254–1255.8 s shows the closed concrete underside, repeated girders and forked supports. Lane width 3.5 m, combined shoulders 1.6 m, local deck 13 m above adjacent racing street, 0.9 m slab and 32 m support pitch are visual reconstruction estimates, not surveyed dimensions. Deck height uncertainty is ±3 m. Supports avoid every protected racing corridor and existing building. The known elevated-road DSM is replaced only beneath these actual deck footprints on land; ambiguous mall/layer-2 terrain is untouched.

landmarks.name: Anderson Bridge
landmarks.road_clearance_exception: Arched cross ties and suspended event panels are overhead; the three ground-level trusses stay outside the left-opening legal road and its protection.
landmarks.dimensions_status: Mapped deck axis; heritage drawing topology and original onboard appearance. Member sizes, clear opening, arch heights and event offsets are bounded reconstructions, not a structural survey. Conflicting 20ft/26ft height descriptions remain disclosed.

landmarks.name: NS Square construction frontage
landmarks.source_note: Actual mapped construction parcel and street-facing boundary. Supplied 1250.81 s shows pale construction frontage behind race fencing. PUB confirms demolition and redevelopment during 2023–2027. Hoarding height and support spacing are estimates; no finished future stadium is invented.

landmarks.name: Ritz-Carlton mapped three-storey podium and glazed barrel-vault entrance
landmarks.source_note: Mapped 16 m/three-level outline, primary BCA description and owner entryway photo. Granite-coloured piers, glazing and an aluminium/glass barrel vault replace a generic roof-based extrusion. Exact vault width, position and mullion sizes are estimates.

landmarks.name: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore mapped slender tower and exposed legs
landmarks.source_note: Previously omitted OSM building-part outline: height 140 m, min_height 30 m, 32 levels. Owner describes 37 m stilt-like legs, while BCA places first guestrooms about 30 m above street. The rendered 37 m clearance follows the owner, with the 30–37 m source discrepancy retained. Twenty-nine upper floor bands follow the mapped three-level podium offset; exact window spacing is reconstructed. No source pixels are shipped.

landmarks.name: Ritz-Carlton mapped rising lobby driveway
landmarks.source_note: Exact mapped access paths 620797981/784662624/741167072 connect Raffles Avenue with the podium. Marriott identifies the lobby on Level 3; the owner shows the glazed barrel-vault arrival. The 8.0 m rise, 4.8 m pavement width and retaining edges are reconstructed estimates, not survey. The raised driveway is retained instead of flattening the entire hotel property. Paving beyond the closed race wall is visual only.

landmarks.name: Fairmont Singapore
landmarks.source_note: Retained OSM building-part ring and height/min_height tags share the existing 30 m mall podium. Height is total above ground, not additional to the podium. Floor-band, bay and crown details are reconstructed estimates; no source pixels are used.

landmarks.name: Singapore floodlight recipe
landmarks.structure: Small race fittings at roughly 7 m intervals along continuous paired cables, supported about every 42 m; pit-side cable posts attach above the garage roof. Separate civic lamps include taller curved streetlamps along Esplanade Drive. Anderson Bridge and the ECP crossings have gradual cable-height transitions. Estimated 9.5 m ECP fittings remain below the reconstructed soffit; field power and pool radius are unchanged.
landmarks.confidence: High for continuous cable strings and separate streetlamps; moderate for bridge distinction; low for metric height/spacing estimates. Cable support registrations are authoring estimates.
